 ----Petitioner

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 Bench At Jaipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Prakash
Thakuriya Pp Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kanwaljit Singh Ahluwalia
-/Order/-
05/12/2018
Learned counsel for the petitioner has stated at Bar that on 1.6.2010 sample of Ghee from the shop of petitioner was drawn by Food Inspector.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has contended that the State Food Laboratory vide report dated 24.6.2010 found the sample to be adulterated.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has contended that eleven months later on 21.5.2011 Health Authority i.e. Chief Medical and Health Officer ordered prosecution of the petitioner.
It is submitted that the complaint was filed on 14.6.2011 almost after one year.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that shelf life of Ghee is six months.
It is submitted that on 17.7.2011 petitioner received notice under Section 13(2) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
It is contended that within ten days on 23.7.2011 petitioner filed an application for sending the second sample to the Central Food Laboratory.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has contended that even though the court passed the order, the second sample was (2 of 2) [CRLMP-6148/2017] produced in the court on 2.9.2017 after delay of more than seven years.
Issue notice to the respondents for 4.2.2019.

Meanwhile, further proceedings in the court below qua the petitioner shall remain stayed.
(KANWALJIT SINGH AHLUWALIA),J Mak/-
